title: Daughter Kills Her Dad After Being Told To Move Out
description:
Bodycam footage shows the investigation into the death of a Florida man. Richard Langer called 911 and told police him and his wife were stabbed, identifying the suspect as his daughter before he passed away. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
